CustomField.description: Heading/title text for the post-submission confirmation (wrap-up) page; also used as the tab and progress-indicator label for that page. Plain text.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The short label shown for the confirmation page in the form's navigation tabs and stage indicator. Keep it to a word or two, such as Done or Confirmation, since long text crowds the indicator.
CustomField.label: Confirmation Page Label
